# Company Overview

**BioNTech**是一家总部位于德国Mainz的生物技术公司，最初因mRNA疫苗平台和Comirnaty广为人知，目前也在肿瘤免疫治疗、ADC和细胞治疗领域积极布局。

在肿瘤领域，BioNTech的重要项目包括：

- [Pumitamig](../compound/Pumitamig.qmd)，PD-L1 × VEGF-A双特异性抗体，与[Bristol Myers Squibb](BMS.qmd)共同开发；
- [Elfetabart drozuntecan / Elfe-D](../compound/Elfe_D.qmd)，[B7-H3](../target/B7-H3.qmd)-targeted [ADC](../other/ADC.qmd)，与[DualityBio](DualityBio.qmd)合作开发。

# Selected Products and Programs

| Product or program | Modality | Area |
|---|---|---|
| Comirnaty | mRNA vaccine | Infectious disease |
| [Pumitamig](../compound/Pumitamig.qmd) | PD-L1 × VEGF-A bispecific antibody | Oncology |
| [Elfe-D](../compound/Elfe_D.qmd) | [B7-H3](../target/B7-H3.qmd)-targeted ADC | Oncology |
